content.short: SOURC3 is an on-chain reputation system for blockchain software developers and a cross-collaboration platform similar to GitHub.
content.description: SOURC3 is an on-chain reputation system for blockchain software developers. It also functions as a cross-collaboration software development platform, similar to GitHub. Users can export their code from GitHub into SOURC3, which is open-source, decentralized and censorship-resistant. By linking decentralized identities, contribution provenance and on-chain metadata, SOURC3 powers the KYD, or 'Know Your Developer,' standard, creating a durable framework for evaluating and trusting developer contributions across projects.
content.meta: SOURC3 is a Web3-native, decentralized platform for on-chain reputation management. Discover SOURC3 and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
